paragraphs: I'm Hoang Van Dieu (HOANGDIEUIT) — an Information Technology graduate from the Posts and Telecommunications Institute of Technology (PTIT, 2020–2025), specializing in backend system architectures integrated with Large Language Models and agentic frameworks.

Currently an AI Engineer at WeUpBook following roles at NewWave Solutions JSC and Bamboo Viet Technology JSC — I build multi-agent workflows, high-concurrency RAG retrieval pipelines, and containerized Python microservices engineered for production reliability.

finale.summary: From edge computer vision and Japanese enterprise backends to production-scale Multi-Agent and RAG platforms — grounded in real engineering.

items.project: MULTI-AGENT PLATFORM · NOTEBOOK AI STUDIO · A2UI COMMERCE
points: Design and ship production-ready AI applications powered by LLMs, RAG, and multi-agent architectures using FastAPI, LangGraph, LangChain, and Google ADK.
Engineer scalable backend microservices and vector retrieval pipelines with Milvus, Qdrant, Redis, RabbitMQ, and MinIO for high-concurrency workloads.
Cut inference costs by 90%+ and keep latency under 2s via semantic caching, async task execution, and containerized Docker deployments.

items.project: ENTERPRISE MICROSERVICES (JP MARKET) · NVIDIA RAG · AGENTIC MVP
points: Developed and maintained Python (Django, FastAPI) backend services and RESTful APIs for enterprise systems serving the Japanese market.
Architected microservice pipelines integrating PostgreSQL, Redis, RabbitMQ, MinIO, and Docker while leading internal NVIDIA Blueprint & Agentic RAG initiatives.
Tuned database throughput, maintained CI/CD & Docker infrastructure, and mentored interns through code reviews and clean architecture practices.

items.project: INDUSTRIAL IOT · EDGE COMPUTER VISION · SMART HARDWARE
points: Developed embedded C/C++ and Python software for smart IoT hardware, integrating sensors, microcontrollers, and MQTT / serial protocols.
Built and optimized real-time OpenCV and Deep Learning vision pipelines for object detection, tracking, and industrial automation.
Executed hardware-software integration testing, edge inference optimization, and field deployments in production environments.
